title: 1969 AHSME Problem 8
statement: Triangle \(ABC\) is inscribed in a circle. The measures of the non-overlapping minor arcs \(AB,\) \(BC,\) and \(CA\) are, respectively, \(x+75^\circ,\) \(2x+25^\circ,\) \(3x-22^\circ.\) Then one interior angle of the triangle, in degrees, is:

solutions.text:
The arc sum gives \[ \begin{aligned} 6x+78&=360,\\ x&=47. \end{aligned} \] The arcs then measure \(122^\circ,\) \(119^\circ,\) and \(119^\circ.\) The angle intercepting the \(122^\circ\) arc measures \(61^\circ.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
hints: The three non-overlapping arcs sum to \(360^\circ\)
Each inscribed angle is half the measure of its intercepted arc
